title: On Refreshing the travellers with cold water
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：refresh　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 refresh 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the farmer ① refreshed the travellers with cold water on the same day, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② refreshes the travellers with cold water before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ refresh the travellers with cold water at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ refreshed the travellers with cold water before — a line in the almanac for September 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Refreshing the travellers with cold water on the same day, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ refresh the stores before the winter before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Refresh the stores before the winter at once and never mention it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ refreshes the stores before the winter on the same day every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ refreshed the travellers with cold water again when nobody else would.

⑩ To refresh the travellers with cold water, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody refreshes the travellers with cold water before dawn again and somebody must refresh the travellers with cold water on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使清爽（一般过去式 refreshed the travellers with cold water：1979 年农人头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 使清爽（一般现在 refreshes the travellers with cold water：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使清爽（不定式 to refresh the travellers with cold water：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使清爽（过去完成时 had refreshed the travellers with cold water：1973 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 使清爽（动名词 refreshing the travellers with cold water 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 补充（refresh the stores before the winter：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去补充入冬前把存粮补足）
G. v. 补充（refresh the stores before the winter：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使清爽（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 refreshes the stores before the winter，而母亲又一次 refreshed the travellers with cold water）

refresh 意为“使清爽”，新来的孩子每个秋天都照例补充入冬前把存粮补足，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 refreshes。

refresh 意为“使清爽”，结尾那句是母亲 1991 年的话：要使清爽用凉水让旅人们清爽一下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 refresh 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the farmer refreshed the travellers with cold water on the same day, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer refreshes the travellers with cold water before dawn whenever the field asks.
Refreshing the travellers with cold water on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever refresh the stores before the winter before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next field refreshes the stores before the winter on the same day every autumn, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother refreshed the travellers with cold water again, and the field remembered that half.
